gaps: No source gives the date motorcycles were first allowed over Shinku La in 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026.
Opening date for 2023 and closing dates for 2021, 2022 and 2025 not found.
A bridge collapse reported on 1 May 2026 comes from a search result only and was not confirmed.
No official source found for the rule that Zanskar needs no permit; whether foreign citizens need one was not established.
Whether the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh is enforced in Zanskar was not found.
Whether the e-Aagman vehicle pass is enforced on motorcycles was not confirmed.
Sources give 16,700 feet and about 16,580 feet for Shinku La; the encyclopedia figure is used.
The fuel claim about Darcha is a blogger's; it was not checked against a pump list.
Usual days rests on a blogger's description of a long single-day drive.
The first video gives no filming date; it was published on 14 June 2025.
